signs.text: CARLO GATTI. A Swiss-Italian cafe owner who, from the 1850s, shipped ice from Norway into London and stored it in deep brick wells beside the Regent's Canal. London got ice cream out of the deal.

text: The well is a brick-lined hole going down further than your light does. Ice cut in Norway once kept down here well into the summer.
In a niche, a jam jar of old pennies. Gatti sold ice cream at a penny a glass, so that seems fair.
